t: The third paragraph of section 4008 of title 18, United States Code, is amended by striking out, immediately after “State,”, the words “War, or the Navy,”, and inserting in lieu thereof the words “the Army, Navy, or Air Force,”.

fable.w: This is a purely technical amendment that updates the names of military departments in 18 U.S.C. 4008. No tempting reading exists: it creates no comment period, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, consultation with outside parties, or right to sue. The only entities mentioned are federal departments, which are inside the federal government.
